source.timestamp_convention: scene start and end UTC parsed from the NOAA filename

temporal_alignment.selection: latest scene whose end timestamp is at or before the radar window start
temporal_alignment.causality: Each ABI scene must end at or before its radar window start. Temporal derivatives are not part of v2.

target_grid.projection: AEQD spherical centred at the Sumaré radar

normalization.rationale: ABI infrared CMI is stored as brightness temperature in kelvin. This fixed physical scale avoids fitting statistics on validation or test years; a train-only standardization may be added in a later version.
